metadata.description: Build the Linux Terminal's git store guard (store-guard/, Rust, static musl) and stage it with its NOTICE and manifest under out/store-guard/linux-x64 (Linux git parity blueprint, LP2 and LP8). Linux x64 only; rustup installs the pinned toolchain on first run.

The store guard's Rust unit tests, clippy (warnings denied) and rustfmt. The mounted acceptance cases (store-guard/tests/acceptance.sh) need FUSE and bubblewrap and run in the Linux shell-conformance guest.

Build the Windows shell sandbox helper (windows-sandbox/, Rust, static CRT) as tau-windows-sandbox.exe for x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, refuse it unless it is an x64 console executable that imports no Visual C++ runtime DLL and answers `status`, and stage it with its NOTICE and manifest under out/windows-sandbox/win32-x64. It also builds the conformance row's stand-in native worker (examples/tau-worker-probe.exe), which is never staged or installed. Windows x64 only: it links against the MSVC toolchain. Elsewhere use `cargo check --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` in the crate.

The Windows sandbox helper's portable unit tests (frame codec, spec validation, journal format, path checks, CLI). They run on any host; the Win32 code behind cfg(windows) is exercised by the Windows conformance row.
The staging scripts' own checks, on any host: the Windows helper's ship gate (an x64 console executable importing no Visual C++ runtime DLL) against synthetic PE images.

The native shell conformance rows (T02, E rows a provider owns): the real sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash, positive controls before negatives, network negatives judged by canaries outside the sandbox. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Cacheable only under the shell environment fingerprint (scripts/src/shell-evidence.ts, CF-1): the hash covers the source closure and the row's OS, kernel, Bash, runner image, sandbox runtime and node-pty, and is a fresh nonce unless the run asked for reuse, so candidate, drift and promotion runs never hit. A hit restores the receipt that first proved the verdict and its verdict record; the workflow's uncached stamp step says so. On win32 run the `windows` configuration (WIN-X64): the Windows provider and PowerShell rows of shell.conformance.windows.test.ts, in a command cmd.exe parses; it fails, never skips, off Windows or without the helper's elevated setup.
